downscope_contract.summary: Defines the safe near-term lane as manual/fail-closed ASL learning practice with local camera framing, metadata-only saved history, content-only vocabulary, lesson/validation surfaces, and no machine recognition claims while the model is not trained.
downscope_contract.blocked_work_summary: Blocks Brev/GPU work, training/evaluation reruns, export, promotion, browser activation, implementation/runtime claim expansion, source/data/dependency mutation, label expansion, raw learner video upload, and pretrained/generated-label paths unless a future prompt or human approval authorizes a bounded strategy.
downscope_contract.artifact_meaning: M3EV copied artifacts are diagnostic accounting evidence only, not browser artifacts, model-readiness evidence, active-vocabulary evidence, or product authority.
downscope_contract.resume_ml_requirements: Future ML work needs a new explicit prompt or human approval with a hypothesis not already falsified, exact source/label/representation/architecture change, bounded diagnostic or compute receipt, promotion gates, and explicit non-promotion of M3EV artifacts.
downscope_contract.product_hardening_gates: Keep model-card not_trained, activeLabels empty, browser recognition disabled, no correctness/readiness claims, no raw video upload, consent-gated collection only, metadata-only attempts, and current validation/claim surfaces.

negative_authorizations: no worker lifecycle command except emergency stop if read-only state unexpectedly reports RUNNING
no local or remote training command
do not stage or commit ignored model artifacts under output/
next_action_reason: The contract pins a safe fail-closed lane, and inspection found stale or ambiguous README-level mission/pass-fail wording that should be reduced before additional product hardening.
